que_sale: Los productos quietos, como una foto, con gotas resbalando por el cristal.
Encima, la oferta en letra grande («25 % en toda la web»).
Sin personas y sin cortes: de 6 a 10 segundos muy cuidados.
por_que: Parece una foto de lujo pero se mueve, así que llama la atención en el feed. Perfecto para anunciar una oferta como tu Black Week.
basado_en: Biossance: sus productos quietos con gotas resbalando por el cristal y la oferta encima («Static to video», varias versiones activas en Meta).
herramienta: ChatGPT o Gemini (foto) → Kling o Veo (vídeo)
adjuntar: Adjunta las 4 fotos de referencia (sérum, tarro verde, textura y aceite).

planos.prompt: Vertical 9:16 luxury still life for a skincare campaign. The three rizelune products from the attached photos (the sage-green scrub jar, the serum dropper bottle and the facial oil with its cream box), exactly as in the references, with every label unchanged and readable stand together on a warm beige travertine stone block, against a deep, softly lit warm-brown background. A few drops of golden oil and tiny water droplets sit on the glass, one rosemary sprig lies on the stone. Warm side light with a soft glow and gentle reflections on the glass, high-end, calm and elegant. Leave clean empty space in the top third for text. No added text, no watermark.

Vertical 9:16, 6 seconds, starting exactly from the attached image. Static camera with an extremely slow push-in. Tiny droplets slowly run down the glass of the bottles, a single golden drop falls from the serum dropper onto the stone, and warm light shimmers softly across the products. The products and their labels stay perfectly still, sharp and unchanged. Audio: soft ambient tone and a delicate drip, no music, no voice. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no added logos, no watermark.
